brief:
Benjamin Netanyahu's parliamentary bloc has fallen to 53 seats as Israel counted 85.6 percent of ballots, according to Middle East Eye. Parties seeking to remove the prime minister hold a combined 67 seats in the latest projections, leaving Netanyahu eight seats short of a 61-seat majority in parliament.

The results signal a significant shift in Israeli politics, with anti-Netanyahu parties substantially outnumbering his supporters as counting continues.

title: Netanyahu's bloc loses majority as Israel counts most ballots
